title: Admission-budget exhaustion in the retry tick can override an authority-changed, interrupted-with-intent or cleanup hold on the same tick
outcome: engram_begin_preparation_lineage_step no longer overrides a protective decision the retry kind's own step would make on the same tick. When the authority changed, the head is interrupted with retained intent another path owns, a dedicated cleanup holds admission, or a runtime stop is in progress, exhaustion leaves that hold in place instead of making the head resumable. Tests cover each case with an exhausted budget.
acceptance: Admission-budget exhaustion in the retry tick can override an authority-changed, interrupted-with-intent or cleanup hold on the same tick is done
